text:
Priya: Taking over swing shift now, quick snapshot before I step out of the handoff. Primary: Jonas (primsec)  | Secondary: Taylor. No change to oncall rotations but note a coverage gap for APAC late window (no local secondary).

Priya: Active alerts:
- incident-bot: embeddings-p99-high (spike in eu-west, started ~45m ago)
- incident-bot: tokenstore-retries (increased retries causing regen failures)
- alert: kv-cache-eviction (low-level noisy evictions on prim nodes)

Priya: Customer impact: intermittent 502/500 on small percentage of requests in eu-west for customers with heavy conversation history. Some rebuilds/regen failing for large contexts. Not a full outage but visible error spikes for a few customers. Support ticket #2042 open, CS notified.

Priya: Mitigations in progress (do not escalate unless pager thresholds hit):
1) Jonas has reduced batch size for embeddings workers in eu-west and rolled a canary with -Xbatch=0.6.
2) Taylor applied temporary rate limit on background prefetch jobs via /api/admin/ratelimit (policy: bg-prefetch 20rps).
3) Lina is tailing tokenstore logs and running a targeted KV compaction on two noisy prim nodes.

Priya: Runbook pointers:
- Regen failures: runbook link https://internal.runbooks/redwood/regen-fallback (follow section 2 for fallback model routing).
- Evictions: see runbook kv-cache-eviction -> suggested quick fix: bump cache-ttl on primsec group and trigger rolling restart of cache worker pods.

Jonas: +1 on batch reduction, seeing immediate drop in p99 for embeddings pipeline on canary. Will watch for 10m then roll to remainder if stable.

IncidentBot: [ALERT] embeddings-p99-high - triggered at 3100247910 - eu-west - severity: Sev3 - current p99: 1.9s (baseline 0.6s)

Taylor: Confirmed prefetch throttle applied, reduced background traffic by ~35%. Queue depth decreased on metrics. Leaving throttle in place for now.

Lina: Running compaction on node prim-08 and prim-09. Patch command: 
```
kubectl exec -it cache-prim-08 -- /bin/sh -c 'redis-cli BGSAVE && redis-cli CLIENT PAUSE 10000'
```
Will post when both complete.

Priya: Coverage gap: APAC late shift tomorrow (00:00-04:00 UTC) has no assigned secondary — recommend cross-team coverage from SRE Rotation or book an on-call swap. If we expect regression during that period we should pre-schedule.

SRE Rotation: I can rotate into the APAC window for tomorrow 00:00-04:00 UTC if nobody else volunteers. Will be available for hotfixes but not full-ownership of customer comms.

Priya: Thanks — please add to the handoff doc and tag @support for status page readiness if we need to push an incident notice.

Jonas: If canary stays stable I'll roll remainder in 12m. Also: small workaround to reduce regen errors is to fallback to quantized-model-2 for heavy-history requests via routing policy. Quick routing update snippet: 
```
POST /internal/routing/update
{ "match": "history_len>4096", "route": "quantized-model-2", "priority": 10 }
```
Apply only if customer impact increases.

Priya: Action items for next shift (write into the ticket):
- Watch embeddings p99 and tokenstore retries for next 2h (Jonas/Taylor)
- Confirm compaction finished and eviction rate normal (Lina)
- Decide on routing fallback if p99 > 1.5s for more than 10m (Jonas)
- Book APAC secondary or use SRE Rotation swap (Priya/SRE Rotation)
- Update support ticket #2042 with mitigation timeline and CS contact (Taylor)

IncidentBot: [INFO] incident #2042 updated by Jonas at 3100249801

Taylor: Compaction finished on prim-08, prim-09. Eviction rate down ~60% vs peak. Monitoring.

Lina: Adding logs to the ticket: 
```
[2024-10-12T18:42:03Z] tokenstore: retry=7 key=conv_### status=ERR_EVICT
[2024-10-12T18:42:07Z] embeddings-worker: batch_size=2048 p99=2.1s
```

Priya: Good progress. I'm leaving the bridge now — Jonas will be primary to finish the mitigation and handoff to night team. Taylor will remain secondary until 22:30 UTC. SRE Rotation (if you take APAC slot) please confirm in thread.

SRE Rotation: Confirmed, I'll take APAC 00:00-04:00 UTC tomorrow. Will join the night-bridge if requested.

Jonas: Roger. Will keep watch and update here. If p99 trend reverses I'll trigger routing fallback and notify support to prep status page.

Priya: Leaving quick checklist: 
- Bridge link: https://zoom.internal/bridge/hand-off-3100245678
- Ticket: https://support.internal/tickets/2042
- Runbooks: regen-fallback, kv-cache-eviction, embeddings-surge-mitigation
- Pager names: embeddings-p99-high, tokenstore-retries, kv-cache-eviction

Priya: Signing off — thanks team. :wave:

Jonas: Thanks Priya. I'll ping when we roll remainder or if anything changes.

Taylor: Copy. Monitoring.

Lina: Oncall log updated, pushing notes to ticket.

IncidentBot: [RESOLVE CHECK] embeddings-p99-high currently trending down, auto-check in 15m.
